config.sampling: deterministic evenly spaced by (game_id, ply) within each conflict state
config.history_reconstruction: same game's prior states on the same player's turns, last 16; matches generator's persistent per-player AI instances
config.history_empty_definition: fresh QuoridorAI; choose_action records current root state itself

interpretation_limits: An action difference proves history can affect the teacher decision on this board; it does not by itself prove that history caused the eventual game winner.
A longer time budget with the same max_depth isolates deadline sensitivity, not deeper search strength.

The audit replays the current checked-out Advanced AI implementation. If that implementation differs from the exact code revision used to generate EXP-001, this is a reproduction audit rather than bit-exact historical replay.
Evenly sampled occurrences cover every conflict state but may not include every trajectory occurrence when the per-state limit is nonzero.
